verdicts.reason: A keeps the three text lines in one right-hand group, but the reading order is reversed (AGENCY, then subtitle, then HOHOHO), the big blue ring and red zigzag crowd the left edge of the copy, and the bottom is a jammed pile of clipped confetti shapes. B breaks the lockup apart: HOHOHO sits top-left, AGENCY bottom-left and the subtitle wraps to an orphaned 'Santa' in the middle-right among busy shapes, with the decorations scattered as cut fragments, so it no longer reads as a designed piece.
